title: The perfect app
body:
I’ve been using Obsidian for a while using all types of plugins and writing custom code just to achieve 20% of what this app is and I’m very happy with it.

Would love to see the ability to link screen time with some of the habits, for example link a habit like Reading to any book reader, or a bad habit that automatically fetches social media screen time etc. Less friction = Better consistency.
